Agadir Agreement Free Trade Area (Egypt, Jordan, Morocco, Tunisia) (2007)
Double Taxation Avoidance Agreements with United Kingdom (1980), Germany (1987), China (2015), United Arab Emirates (2019), and Saudi Arabia (2007)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law No. 80 of 2002 on Combating Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing, as amended by Law No. 181 of 2022, and its Executive Regulations issued by Prime Ministerial Decree No. 95 of 2004, as amended; Companies Law No. 72 of 2023 and its Executive Regulations (Prime Ministerial Decree No. 2184 of 2023), imposing the obligation to maintain and file a register of actual beneficiaries; Unified Commercial Registration Law No. 34 of 1976; Financial Regulatory Authority Board Resolution No. 124 of 2019 on the Beneficial Owner Register; complementary GAFI and Egyptian Tax Authority AML/CFT directives; FATF Recommendations 10, 22, 24 and 25 as transposed into Egyptian subordinate legislation.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Founding entity Certificate of Good Standing or Certificate of Corporate Existence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies Registry or Trade Register in the founder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille where the country of origin is an Apostille Convention member; otherwise Consular Legalization route consisting of origin Ministry of Foreign Affairs attestation followed by Egyptian Embassy/Consulate legalization. Egypt is not a party to the Hague Apostille Convention of 1961, therefore consular legalization is the standard mandatory route for Egyptian filing.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney appointing the Egyptian incorporation agent and signatories
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the founder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization, or Apostille when the country of origin is an Apostille state, followed by certified Arabic translation and attestation before an Egyptian public notary at the Egyptian Ministry of Justice.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution or Shareholders' Resolution approving the Egyptian LLC establishment, capitalization and authorized representatives
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Founding entity board of directors or shareholders
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization in the country of origin followed by Consular Legalization or Apostille, then GAFI-accepted Arabic translation certified by an Egyptian licensed translator and notarized.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Passport copies and civil-status documents of all UBOs, directors and authorized signatories
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport authority or civil registry of the person's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Certified true copies attested by the consular officer at the Egyptian Embassy or Consulate in the country of origin, or by apostille where applicable, with Egyptian notarial certification of the Arabic translation.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based screening of all UBOs, directors, authorized signatories, clearing-bank signed officers and beneficial controllers against: (i) the United Nations Security Council consolidated sanctions lists, including the ISIL/Al-Qaida 1267, Taliban 1988 and DPRK 1718 regimes; (ii) the United States OFAC SDN List; (iii) the European Union consolidated financial sanctions list; (iv) the Egyptian domestic terrorist list maintained by the competent Egyptian authority and circulated through the Central Bank of Egypt; and (v) the Egyptian AML Law No. 80 of 2002 and its Executive Regulations requiring customer due diligence, beneficial ownership identification, and transaction monitoring. Politically Exposed Persons, both domestic and foreign, are subject to enhanced due diligence in accordance with FATF Recommendations 12 and 24, including source-of-wealth and source-of-funds verification, senior management approval before establishing or continuing the corporate relationship, and ongoing enhanced monitoring throughout the life of the engagement.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: GAFI e-Services One-Stop-Shop (OSS) company formation portal at www.gafi.gov.eg, integrated with the Unified Commercial Registry platform 'Tegaraty' at www.tegaraty.gov.eg
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory legal name must be expressed in Arabic script and must include the suffix 'شركة ذات مسؤولية محدودة' (Limited Liability Company) or an approved abbreviation; a Latin-script transliteration or secondary English trade name may be submitted to GAFI and entered into the Unified Commercial Register as a parallel name. The Arabic name must be distinctive, must not duplicate or resemble a previously registered commercial name, must not be misleading as to the corporate object, and must adhere to the Unified Commercial Registry's script transliteration technical standards. Foreign-investor LLCs are permitted to register an English secondary name alongside the mandatory Arabic legal name.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank / Central / National / Reserve - reserved for institutions licensed by the Central Bank of Egypt
Insurance / Takaful / Pension - reserved for entities licensed under the Financial Regulatory Authority insurance sector rules
Securities / Brokerage / Market Making / High Frequency Trading - requires prior FRA non-objection under Capital Market Law No. 95 of 1992
Islamic / Sharia-compliant / Murabaha - requires CBE and FRA sharia governance clearance
Egyptian / Arab / Nile / Ministry / Government - reserved for sovereign or Cabinet-authorized use
Trust / Charity / Foundation - restricted to non-profit or special statutory vehicles approved by the competent authority
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon issuance of a name clearance rejection, the applicant must file a written administrative appeal with the GAFI Name Clearance Unit within 15 working days from the date of the electronic rejection notice, restating the proposed name and attaching legal justifications and any supporting authorization from sectoral regulators where a sensitive token is involved. GAFI is required to complete its internal review within 15 working days from the appeal filing. If the rejection is confirmed on second instance, the applicant may escalate to the GAFI Legal Affairs Committee for final administrative review, and thereafter to the Egyptian Council of State (Administrative Court) within 60 days from the final administrative decision. In parallel, the applicant may immediately file one or more alternative name applications through the GAFI OSS portal without prejudice to the pending appeal. Names containing sensitive tokens remain conditionally withheld until the relevant ministerial or FRA/CBE authorization is submitted.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible as a final registered office. Egyptian law mandates a physical, identifiable and accessible registered office in the jurisdiction for LLC incorporation under Companies Law No. 72 of 2023. For the intended proprietary high-frequency trading activity falling under Capital Market Law No. 95 of 1992, the FRA additionally requires a dedicated physical head office in Egypt with on-site trading and compliance infrastructure, low-latency data-network or co-location arrangements, business-continuity facilities, and resident compliance officers. A virtual office may only serve as a temporary provisional address during the pre-incorporation and pre-licensing phase; it must be replaced by a fully verifiable leased physical premises before the FRA license dossier is submitted.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High. Quantified at approximately 70 to 80 percent probability that the FRA conducts an announced or unannounced on-site inspection within the first 12 months following capital-market license commencement. GAFI and the Unified Commercial Registry additionally perform cyclical registered-address verifications, and the Central Bank of Egypt may conduct inspections of the clearing, settlement and funding interfaces for AML/CFT adequacy.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Justice - Public Notary Office
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notary tariff plus prevailing certified translation per-page rates

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: GAFI LLC incorporation registration and company master-file creation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official schedule under Companies Law No. 72 of 2023 implementation including e-portal and data-entry fees

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication of the incorporation summary in the Egyptian Official Gazette (Al-Waqa'i' al-Misriyya)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory advertising tariff per page for corporate announcements

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Unified Commercial Registry filing and registration certificate (Tegaraty)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under Unified Commercial Registration Law No. 34 of 1976

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Consular legalization of foreign corporate and identity documents at Egyptian missions abroad and origin-state foreign ministries

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory electronic registration fee and stamp duties (approximately EGP 2,000)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing Cairo market benchmark for foreign-owned LLC formation including AML/UBO certification and FRA pre-licensing consultation (flat fee range USD 3,500-5,500)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 (as amended by Law No. 4 of 2018 and Executive Regulations), Articles 1-45 governing Limited Liability Companies; read together with Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 and its Executive Regulations.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) - Companies Registry Department, Cairo Headquarters and Governorate Notification Offices.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum of Association, Articles of Association and Form No. 1 (Incorporation Application) filed electronically through the GAFI Investor Services Portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is mandated for an LLC under Law 159/1981; however, bank escrow account confirmation of at least EGP 50,000 (or such amount specified in the Articles) is required to evidence capital availability, with funds released upon issuance of the automatic tax ID and commercial registration certificate.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: 1. That the subscription and allotment of the founding shares as recorded in the shareholders' register be approved; 2. That the registered office be established at the address stated in the Articles of Association, with legal domicile in the Arab Republic of Egypt; 3. That the named directors be appointed as first directors with authority to act; 4. That the authorized representatives be appointed to execute solely all registration, licensing and banking formalities; 5. That the corporate seal be adopted and used pursuant to the management regulations; 6. That this resolution be filed with GAFI and relevant authorities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Investor Services Portal - Commercial Names Unit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit three proposed Arabic or bilingual company names via the GAFI e-service. Pay the EGP 220 name reservation fee. The system will issue an automatic name availability notification. If names are rejected for similarity or public-purpose conflict, refile with a revised name pool; rejection can be cured administratively through a written waiver from the registered owner of the conflicting name.
required_dossiers: National ID or passport copies of natural person founding shareholders
Power of attorney of submitting agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Administrative query response within 5 working days; if still rejected, request reconsideration before GAFI's Legal Affairs Department with evidence of lawful distinctiveness.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and notarization of constitutive documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Legal Office and certified Arabic notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a licensed Egyptian accountant or corporate attorney to prepare the Arabic Memorandum and Articles of Association, including a precise business scope restricting activities to 'algorithmic high-frequency trading principal dealing for own account, market making, and related treasury functions'. Sign and have the founders' signatures authenticated before the GAFI notary division.
required_dossiers: Founder identification documents and specimen signatures
Board resolution if a corporate shareholder is a founding party
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Notarial correction request: resubmit the challenged clause redrafted to conform to Law 159 and GAFI model bylaws; the GAFI notary can issue an administrative correction memo without full re-submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Capital escrow account opening and deposit confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial bank operating under Central Bank of Egypt supervision (approved bank)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary corporate escrow account in the company's proposed name at an approved Egyptian bank and deposit the committed initial capital (minimum EGP 50,000). Obtain a bank certificate of deposit and statement of available funds. The bank is required to freeze funds until the incorporation certificate is issued. If GAFI rejects the application, the deposited capital is returned upon joint instruction of shareholders and GAFI release notice.
required_dossiers: Bank account opening forms and beneficial ownership declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Banking release error or delay is cured by presenting a GAFI rejection notice for refund, or, if accepted, converting the escrow account into the operational corporate account upon presenting the incorporation certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Investor Services Portal, Companies Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upload the notarized Memorandum and Articles, escrow capital certificate, name certificate and founders' documents. Pay the official registration fee (approx. USD 625 equivalent) and the electronic filing surcharge. After GAFI review and approval, the issuance of the incorporation certificate is generated within the stated service level. Upon query, correct and resubmit the challenged data via the same portal.
required_dossiers: Board resolution if any corporate founder exists
Tax clearance or declaration of founders if required by GAFI compliance checks
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a query is raised, respond within 10 working days with amended documents and any clarifying evidence; non-response within 30 days requires a fresh filing. GAFI administrative appeal can be lodged within 15 days against any refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax registration, commercial register activation and post-incorporation formalities
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority and GAFI Commercial Registry (unified one-stop shop)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Once the incorporation certificate is issued, the GAFI one-stop shop simultaneously registers the company for tax ID, VAT (where applicable), withholding tax and commercial registry. The company must then execute the board resolution appointing statutory auditors, open the operating corporate bank account, and apply for a stamped seal. For financial service companies, notify the Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA) within five working days.
required_dossiers: Certificate from GAFI for FRA notification
Economical activity classification code ISIC 6499 / NAICS 523130
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Deficiencies in tax registration are cured by filing a supplementary tax registration form and supporting income documents with the Egyptian Tax Authority's concern office; any penalty for late registration may be waived by demonstrating good faith through the GAFI fast-track complaint mechanism.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA) - Non-Banking Financial Services and Capital Markets Licensing Directorate, with administrative coordination through GAFI for the principal activity of algorithmic proprietary trading and market making.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Capital Markets Algorithmic Trading Dealer License (Proprietary Market Maker and High-Frequency Trading Permit) issued by the FRA pursuant to the Non-Banking Financial Services Law No. 5 of 2021.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category C - Registration Only (no physical industrial manufacturing processes; office, data and trading infrastructure activities are exempt from full EIA study under Law No. 4 of 1994 as amended and Environment Law No. 202 of 2020).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: The facility must comply with Egyptian Law No. 4 of 1994 regarding wastewater standards, ventilation and equipment cooling; no industrial wastewater or VOC process emissions are generated. E-waste and spent server batteries must be transferred to a licensed waste contractor and recorded in annual environmental waste manifests in accordance with Waste Management Regulation 80/2021.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Civil Defense clearance certificate is required for the office/data facility, including fire safety certification for server rooms, automatic fire suppression system testing, emergency egress inspection, electrical load stability review and structural load certification for raised floors and equipment racks. Occupational health and safety clearance is issued by the local governorate labor office confirming appropriate workplace ergonomics, air-conditioning and 24/7 trading-floor risk management.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) – official portal: www.eta.gov.eg; e-invoicing clearance portal: https://einvoicing.eta.gov.eg
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities must register with the ETA to obtain a Tax Card (TIN) and VAT registration certificate. Procedure: submit Form 1 (tax registration) to the competent tax office or use the Investor Services Center; for e-invoicing, complete separate registration via the ETA's e-invoice portal with authentication and digital signature setup. Law No. 91 of 2005 and Law No. 67 of 2016 (VAT).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box or entity classification election under Egyptian law. LLCs are per se taxable entities. Statutory elections may be available under the Income Tax Law for depreciation methods, inventory valuation, or loss carryforward, but no hybrid mismatch election is currently codified.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 annual taxable turnover; mandatory for persons whose taxable supplies per calendar year exceed this threshold. Any foreign entity with a fixed establishment in Egypt performing taxable activities must register regardless of turnover.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time e-invoicing and e-receipt clearance through the ETA's e-invoice portal. All B2B invoices must be submitted in XML/JSON format via authorized APIs with ETA-issued digital certificates; the ETA validates and assigns an invoice code (QR stamp) in real-time. Non-compliance blocks the transaction or triggers penalties.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to exports of goods and services (including qualifying exported financial services) provided the supplier is VAT-registered, the destination is outside Egypt, and the supply satisfies proof of export or offshore service consumption. For algorithmic trading services supplied to non-residents, the exporter must evidence that the recipient is outside Egypt and that the service is attributable to foreign markets under Economic Substance and VAT guidelines.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration, Bill of Lading, Inward Remittance Certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent export zero-rating claims or refund applications trigger a penalty of 100% of VAT evaded, a minimum fine of EGP 5,000, plus interest (statutory late-payment rate). The tax may be retroactively clawed back for up to five years. Criminal penalties include imprisonment. Failure to repatriate export proceeds within 180 days reverses the zero-rating and creates a VAT liability with surcharges.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Egypt maintains a managed floating exchange rate with partial capital account convertibility. Current account transactions are convertible upon submission of supporting documentation. Capital account items, including equity contributions and profit repatriation for foreign-owned LLCs, require CBE prior approval and are subject to repatriation limits and documentation verification. Profit remittances are permitted after corporate tax clearance but remain subject to enhanced AML monitoring.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Egyptian entities must surrender 100% of export proceeds to authorized banks within three months of collection. Conversion to Egyptian pounds occurs at the official CBE rate. Algorithmic trading activities classified as financial services are subject to analogous forex surrender protocols upon receipt of any foreign exchange earnings, with full documentation of underlying transactions required.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility rating. CBE regulations prohibit unlicensed cross-border electronic money issuance and require all digital payment services to be conducted through licensed Egyptian banks or approved fintech partnerships.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence of directors and authorized signatories is mandatory for KYC interviews and account opening; remote digital onboarding is not permitted under current CBE guidelines.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership structure inconsistencies or links to high-risk jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified ownership declarations, passport copies, proof of address, source of funds affidavits, and CBE foreign investment approval certificates
Enhanced due diligence reports, legal opinions confirming corporate structure, and transaction history documentation

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound capital injections routed via SWIFT MT103 with purpose code 'Capital Contribution' or 'Equity Injection'. All transactions require submission of CBE foreign investment approval and ownership percentage documentation for bank verification.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound disbursements for trade settlements processed via SWIFT MT103 wire transfers and issuance of Commercial Letters of Credit through correspondent banking networks. All payments must reference underlying trade contracts and comply with CBE import/export regulations.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Currency swaps and cross-currency basis swaps

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual audited financial statements approved by the shareholders and filed with the commercial registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Registry, Ministry of Trade and Industry; duplicate copy to the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after the end of the fiscal year; for a 31 December year-end, no later than 30 June of the succeeding year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Graduated late-filing fines, typically EGP 1,000 to EGP 10,000; suspension of commercial-registry extracts; administrative strike-off after two consecutive annual defaults, with loss of limited-liability protection for obligations contracted during the default period.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (Form 19) with audited financial statements and tax-reconciliation schedules
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), Ministry of Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months after the end of the tax period; for a 31 December year-end, no later than 30 April of the succeeding year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty of 2% per month on the final tax due; interest on unpaid tax; administrative assessment if the return remains unfiled for 60 days after notice; blockage of all commercial-registry transactions until the filing is regularized.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual UBO register confirmation and share-transfer notification
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) and the Anti-Money Laundering Unit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after the anniversary of incorporation, and within 30 days after any transfer of shares in the LLC
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines up to EGP 500,000 against the entity and responsible managers; prohibition of dividend distributions and share-title registration until the confirmation is lodged; referral to the Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA) enforcement committee for licensed trading activity.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual commercial-registry renewal and update of partner, manager, and registered-office details
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Competent Commercial Registry Office, Ministry of Trade and Industry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual renewal due within the first calendar month following the anniversary of the commercial-registration filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly renewal surcharge; administrative strike-off notice after 6 months of non-renewal; cancellation of commercial registration after 12 months, requiring judicial restoration and re-registration of the LLC.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual capital-market license renewal and financial-soundness attestation for proprietary algorithmic trading
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA), Non-Bank Financial Markets and Instruments Sector
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after approval of the annual financial statements and, in any event, no later than 30 June for a 31 December year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: License suspension or revocation; daily administrative fines; immediate freezing of algorithmic trading access; supervisory notification to the Central Bank of Egypt for cross-border clearing or settlement anomalies.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No size-based exemption for an LLC: each Egyptian LLC must appoint a certified auditor and file audited financial statements with the annual corporate tax return under Companies Law 159/1981 (articles 27-28) and Income Tax Law 91/2005 (article 39); a capital-markets-licensed high-frequency trading entity is additionally subject to mandatory annual FRA audit oversight.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS), converged with IFRS, as issued by the Ministry of Investment; securities-market licensees also apply FRA accounting rules for fair-value measurement of proprietary trading positions.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under AML Law 80/2002 and Cabinet Decree 420/2019, the LLC must maintain a current ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) register. On every incorporation anniversary the manager must lodge a notarized confirmation listing each UBO holding 25% or more of shares or exercising control; any share transfer triggers a separate filing within 30 days. The confirmation must reconcile the register of members with the latest share-transfer instruments and must be countersigned by the auditor before filing with GAFI and the AML Unit.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of Shareholders' and Managers' Meetings

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 500 – USD 1,500 per annum (Cairo registered-office and licensed corporate-agent market range)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,000 – USD 8,000 per annum for a certified audit covering proprietary trading books, exchange confirmations, and tax-reconciled financial statements
